'''Nanta'''<ref name="Name" /> was a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="SWI 150" /> [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] native to the forest [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] who fought against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces who were occupying the moon during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. He was shot and killed by a laser blast from an [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]]. [[Romba/Legends|Romba]], who had been fighting the Imperials alongside Nanta, stayed behind and wept over his fallen comrade.<ref name="Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Corpsey.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Romba weeps for his friend, Nanta.]]
This once-unidentified Ewok was often referred to by fans as "'''Corpsey'''" because of his memorable death scene in ''Return of the Jedi''.<ref>{{JCFCite|url=threads/5682679|board=Classic Trilogy|thread=Do you like Corpsey the Dead Ewok?|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20150930214122/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/do-you-like-corpsey-the-dead-ewok.5682679}}</ref><ref>{{WebCite|url=http://movies.ign.com/articles/611/611885p1.html|text=IGN: Star Wars: Best Background Characters|work=IGN.com|archivedate=20101119064717}}</ref><ref name="SWI 150" /> Author [[Benjamin Harper]] attempted to assign the name '''Lana''' to this Ewok he also would have identified as female in his [[2008]] trivia book ''[[Obsessed With Star Wars]]'', but he was ultimately not allowed to give the slain Ewok a proper name.<ref name="SWArchive-Obsessing Over ''Obsessed With Star Wars''">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/20080808news.html|text=Obsessing Over ''Obsessed With Star Wars''}}</ref>

In [[2012]], a [[Toys "R" Us]] exclusive action figure pack, the Ewok Pack from [[Hasbro]]'s [[Star Wars: Movie Heroes]] set, contained a figure for this character and assigned him the name "Nanta" on the packaging.<ref name="Name" />
